Grill Mesh Cleaning Brush

Product Introduction
This compact cleaning brush is designed for wire racks, grill mesh, barbecue grids, stove areas and narrow gaps. The curved white handle helps guide the brush head around rods and corners, while the grey bristle head wraps around mesh spaces for easier daily cleaning.

Key Features
1. Curved handle shape helps reach wire racks, grill mesh and narrow spaces.
2. Round grey bristle head is suitable for cleaning around rods, edges and gaps.
3. Scraper edge helps loosen stubborn grease or residue before brushing.
4. Hanging hole design makes it easy to store after use.
5. Compact size is convenient for kitchens, barbecue grills, cage racks and wire shelves.

Specifications
Product Type: Grill mesh cleaning brush
Color: White handle with grey brush head
Approximate Size: 17 cm length, 3.5 cm brush head width
Applicable Scenes: Grill rack, barbecue mesh, stove area, wire shelf, sink rack and cage rack cleaning
Design Details: Curved grip handle, wrapped bristle head, scraper edge and hanging hole

1 x Grill mesh cleaning brush
